# SarembokVE

> SarembokVE is an AI execution runtime and developer CLI for orchestration, distributed compute, and OpenAPI contract governance.

## Documentation

- [SarembokVE](https://sarembok.com/): Official project site.
- [Documentation](https://sarembok.com/docs): Platform and developer documentation.
- [About](https://sarembok.com/about): Project overview.
- [SarembokVE on GitHub](https://github.com/jetsontech/SarembokVE): Public source, CLI usage, and release history.
- [Security](https://sarembok.com/security): Security information.
